title: Tonewheel — Drawbar Organ Studio
description: A live additive-synthesis organ: pull 9 drawbars, add percussion, dial in vibrato/chorus and a 2-speed Leslie, then record and export a WAV.
concept: Every note is built from nine live sine oscillators tuned to classic Hammond tonewheel ratios and mixed by nine draggable drawbars, so the timbre is entirely additive rather than sampled. A scanner-style vibrato/chorus stage and a simulated 2-speed rotary Leslie speaker sit after the mixer, and a polyphonic on-screen + computer keyboard lets you play chords across the full manual.
features: 9 draggable drawbars driving real-time additive synthesis with authentic Hammond harmonic ratios
Percussion attack, 6-mode vibrato/chorus scanner, and a 2-speed Leslie rotary speaker effect
8 classic preset stops (Jazz, Rock, Full, Gospel, Flute, Diapason, Reed, Theater) plus save-your-own presets to localStorage
Fully polyphonic on-screen piano and computer-keyboard manual with octave shifting
Live recorder that renders your performance to a downloadable 16-bit PCM WAV file

interaction.mouse: Drag drawbars vertically to mix harmonics; click/drag piano keys to play
interaction.click: Preset stop buttons, effect toggles, record/export controls
interaction.touch: Full multi-touch chord support on the on-screen keyboard and drawbars
interaction.keyboard: A W S E D F T G Y H U J K play one octave; Z/X shift octaves
